question: What is the value of \(9901 \cdot 101 - 99 \cdot 10101?\)
solution:
Splitting the factors into round-number parts reveals matching terms in the two products. By the distributive property,
\[
9901\cdot101=(9900+1)(100+1)=990000+9900+100+1,
\]
and
\[
99\cdot10101=99(10000+100+1)=990000+9900+99.
\]
Subtracting cancels the common terms \(990000+9900\), leaving
\[
100+1-99=2.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{2}\), choice \(\text{A}\).
